list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT selected_model FROM sessions WHERE selected_model IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.input_tokens+m.output_tokens+m.cache_read_tokens+m.cache_write_tokens+m.reasoning_tokens),0) AS total FROM sessions s JOIN session_models m ON m.session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.complete AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM sessions s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.start_time)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(premium_requests),0) AS premium FROM sessions s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.start_time)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS incomplete FROM sessions s WHERE NOT s.complete AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time)

panels.title: Tokens per Day by Token Type

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', s.start_time) AS time, SUM(m.input_tokens) AS "input", SUM(m.output_tokens) AS "output", SUM(m.cache_read_tokens) AS "cache_read", SUM(m.cache_write_tokens) AS "cache_write", SUM(m.reasoning_tokens) AS "reasoning" FROM sessions s JOIN session_models m ON m.session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.complete AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', s.start_time) AS time, m.model AS metric, SUM(m.input_tokens+m.output_tokens+m.cache_read_tokens+m.cache_write_tokens+m.reasoning_tokens) AS value FROM sessions s JOIN session_models m ON m.session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.complete AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', s.start_time) AS time, SUM(s.premium_requests) AS "premium requests" FROM sessions s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cache-Read vs Fresh Input Tokens per Day

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', s.start_time) AS time, SUM(m.cache_read_tokens) AS "cache_read", SUM(m.input_tokens) AS "fresh_input" FROM sessions s JOIN session_models m ON m.session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.complete AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
